name: Revel
description: Revel audits a public website's product positioning, messaging and conversion copy, then returns a Reveal Index score (0-100), a Blindspot Map of findings, a prioritised Blueprint and an Action Queue. Every finding quotes the page text supporting it, and quotes are verified against the pages actually fetched. Analysis is text-only from server-rendered HTML: no page is rendered, so no claim is made about layout, contrast, mobile, performance or technical SEO. A BlindspotLab Limited product.
